openBlocker: Both reported gaps CONFIRMED. (a) deleteBudgetEntry performs a hard DELETE with no affected-row check and returns void, so a wrong in-tenant entryId silently reports success; zero test coverage and zero frontend callers. It IS tenant-scoped, so cross-tenant deletion cannot occur. (b) Case Workspace mutations are membership-only with no role floor — a MEMBER can close/cancel a Case exactly as freely as an OWNER, including DESTRUCTIVE-effect proposals — and no audit trail is written. Both fixes are IN-LEASE but were not made: they are behaviour changes needing owner sign-off, not defect repairs.
